template.title: Mia and the Singing Kite
template.summary: A child, a kite, and a friendly bird work together to solve a gentle problem.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with a [[slot_color]] [[slot_toy]] in the [[slot_garden]].
One sunny day, the [[slot_toy]] flew up high and got stuck in a tall oak tree.
[[slot_child]] thought about using a [[slot_stick]] to pull it down.
But [[slot_child]] remembered the kind [[slot_bird]] that sang in the trees.
[[slot_child]] walked over to the tree and whispered, "Can you help me?"
The [[slot_bird]] fluttered down and said, "I can sing you a song and bring the kite back."
[[slot_child]] smiled and shared a bite of [[slot_snack]] with the bird.
The song made the oak leaves dance, and the kite fell gently to the ground.
[[slot_child]] thanked the bird and gave it a tiny feather.
From then on, every time the kite flew, the bird sang, and they both felt happy.
